TanStack Router useParams from route.description:
Read this route's path params inside its own component. Requires the Route exported by the route module.

在路由自身的组件中读取路径参数；需要该路由模块导出的 Route。

TanStack Router useParams by route id.description:
Read a route's path params from a component that lives outside that route module. Requires useParams from @tanstack/react-router.

在路由模块之外的组件中读取某个路由的路径参数；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 useParams。

TanStack Router getRouteApi.description:
Bind a component outside the route module to one route, so its loader data, params and search stay typed without passing from on every call. Requires getRouteApi from @tanstack/react-router.

把路由模块之外的组件绑定到某个路由，使其 loader 数据、params 与 search 保持类型化，无需每次传 from；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 getRouteApi。

TanStack Router params parse and stringi.description:
Convert a path param between its URL string and the type the route works with. Insert as a route option inside createFileRoute.

在 URL 字符串与路由实际使用的类型之间转换路径参数；作为 createFileRoute 的路由选项插入。
